detail.longDescription: Fotor Video Agent helps founders, marketers, and creators turn ideas, scripts, or raw assets into precision videos & motion graphics. It auto-orchestrates scenes, timing, visual FX, and kinetic typography—while keeping text, numbers, logos, and charts editable on a multi-track timeline before you render. Update stats at the last minute or refine timing without regenerating the whole video. Ship promos and explainers faster with zero black-box outputs and no tedious keyframes.
